decision.title: Book.author: relationship field or Author entity reference
decision.question: Book.author is a field-level connector on GET /authors/{authorId} (the links: form D-ox8zkp confirmed), and Author is also an entity with a type-level connector on the same GET, so lint warns link-key-drift. Keep the relationship field, or map author: { id: authorId } in every Book selection so the router resolves it through the Author entity connector (same request count; Author has no batch endpoint)?

choices.label: Resolve Book.author through the Author entity reference
